summary.one_liner: An MCP server and HTTP REST API that drives Google NotebookLM for citation-backed Q&A and Studio content generation (audio, video, infographics, reports and more), unofficial and not affiliated with Google.
summary.what_it_does: It exposes NotebookLM notebooks to MCP clients such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, and as a 53-endpoint HTTP REST API for tools like n8n, Zapier, Make or curl. It asks questions against notebook sources and returns answers with citations, optionally including quoted source excerpts in several formats. It can generate Studio artifacts (audio overviews, video, infographics, reports, presentations, data tables, flashcards, quizzes, mind maps) and download audio, video and infographic files. Source management covers adding files, URLs, text, YouTube and Google Drive sources, listing, renaming, reading full source text and checking freshness. It uses NotebookLM's internal batchexecute RPC API as the primary transport with a Playwright browser fallback, and supports multi-account rotation with TOTP-based re-authentication. A batch vault tool writes answers to disk as structured JSON for offline querying.
use_cases: Batch research questions against NotebookLM notebooks overnight
Citation-backed answers from uploaded PDFs and URLs
Generating podcast-style audio overviews or videos from sources
Calling NotebookLM as a step in n8n, Zapier or Make workflows
Giving Claude Code or Cursor access to NotebookLM notebooks
Caching NotebookLM answers as a searchable local archive
notable: Dual transport: internal batchexecute RPC API with automatic Playwright browser fallback
Full REST API (53 endpoints per the README, OpenAPI 3.1 spec) plus MCP server from the same package
Multi-account rotation with TOTP auto-reauth across personal and Google Workspace accounts
Answers written to disk as JSON against a published schema (nblm-answer-v1) for offline retrieval
Bundled agent skill covering citation formats and batch patterns
caveats: Unofficial project using undocumented NotebookLM endpoints that may change without notice
Requires Node 22 or newer; remote access and Docker require NOTEBOOKLM_API_KEY per the README
Google may flag automated usage; the README recommends a dedicated Google account and notes NotebookLM quotas apply at high volume
